segmentNote: Segment operating income: Entertainment $1,201M, Sports $802M, Experiences $2,222M (before corporate costs).

takeaways.text: Total segment operating income rose 19% to $4,225M: Entertainment nearly tripled to $1,201M as streaming improved and Inside Out 2 powered content sales, Experiences eased 3% to $2,222M on softer park demand late in the quarter, and Sports slipped 6% to $802M.
takeaways.title: Segment profit jumped

takeaways.text: Disney's combined streaming businesses (Disney+, Hulu and ESPN+) earned $66M — their first profit, and a quarter ahead of Disney's own target. Entertainment's Direct-to-Consumer loss narrowed to just $19M, from $505M a year ago.
takeaways.title: Streaming turned profitable — early

takeaways.text: Unlike the year-ago quarter — which absorbed $2,650M of restructuring and impairment charges and lost $0.25 a share — this quarter had no such charges, and diluted EPS swung to $1.43.
takeaways.title: A clean quarter, for once

verdict: Disney's streaming businesses turned profitable for the first time as Entertainment profit nearly tripled — revenue rose 4% to $23.2B and net income reached $2.8B, a year after a small loss.
